synopsis: Chapter 9 recommends nested validation across site types, using leave-one-site-type-out validation when tuning thresholds, zones and filters to test generalisation to unseen sites [f6995]. The glossary repeats this recommendation for braking-system tuning more broadly [f14311]. It also describes leave-one-site-type-out cross-validation as a method the booklet uses for job sites, although the supplied facts provide no validation results or measured generalisation performance [f14329, f6995, f14311].

relations.note: Both recommend leave-one-site-type-out tuning validation to test generalisation to unseen sites.
Specifies nested validation and threshold, zone and filter tuning for the named method.
